store.title: App Store edition
store.description: Route links by browser. The optional, separately installed Helper adds Chrome and Brave profile selection. Choose your fallback target in Settings.
store.updates: App updates are delivered through the App Store. The optional browser Helper is installed and updated separately. CLI installation is available in the direct edition.
store.settingsSubtitle: Default browser, routing target, appearance and local behavior history.
store.overviewSubtitle: Routing engine status and recent decisions.
store.emptyHint: Open a link through LinkPilot to see routing activity here.
store.pickBrowser: Or choose a browser from the list
store.pickerDescription: Preview the browser chooser and send a test link to the browser you choose.
store.testSubtitle: The result updates as you type. Only clicking Open test link launches the browser.
store.defaultBrowserHint: macOS will ask you to confirm the change.

helper.title: Optional browser Helper
helper.description: Install the separately signed LinkPilot Helper to choose Chrome and Brave profiles. Other browsers continue to open normally. Browser data permissions belong to Helper.
helper.required: Start LinkPilot Helper to use this saved profile.
